Built for the manager-of-workers workflow

## Run a workforce, not a window-juggling act.

Every feature is designed to reduce managerial overhead.

### Parallel workforce

Run as many Claude workers as you want. Each gets a stable identity, its own context, and survives restarts.

### Worker escalation

Deterministic status detection drives macOS notifications and a dock badge the moment a worker needs you.

### Review queue

Approvals from every active worker surface in one place. Resolve them in batches without context-switching.

### Traceability layer

Knowing a worker is done is table stakes. Knowing why it's stuck is the real value. Every worker's thought process is auditable in one timeline.

### Command center

Every active worker, every state, every approval — one frame. Switch into any worker's terminal in a single click.

### MCP profile management

Configure MCP servers globally or per-worker without touching ~/.claude. Toggle tools per worker independently.

### Token oversight

Live input + output tokens per worker, plus lifetime totals across your workforce. Know what every worker is spending.

### Full TUI fidelity

PTY-backed xterm.js. Slash commands, plan mode, approvals, image paste — every Claude CLI feature works exactly as you expect.

### Model-neutral engine Soon

The orchestration layer is model-neutral by design. Compare a Claude worker, a Gemini worker, and a local Llama worker — same workspace, same command center.

Beyond Claude

## Your tools will change. Your command center shouldn't.

The model wars are still being fought. Whoever wins a year from now, you keep your workforce and the workflow you built around it.

### Cross-model review

Have Claude review what Gemini wrote. Catch hallucinations and disagreements before they ship.

### Capability routing

Long-context jobs to one model. Throwaway scripts to a local one. Spend where it matters; save where it doesn't.

### Vendor independence

If pricing changes, a competing tool ships, or the API shifts under you, your workflow doesn't break.

Anthropic will only ever manage Claude workers. Claudeverse manages your AI workforce.

Engine is model-neutral by design today. Multi-vendor UI ships post-MVP1.
